generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Create or modify deterministic source code, scripts, tests, and configuration to implement the required technical function.

contract.purpose_user_function: Create or modify deterministic code, scripts, tests, and configuration through an assigned coding operator.
contract.valid_inputs: Compiled node/envelope, repository files, specifications, write scope, toolchain, tests, and selected physical coding operator.
contract.expected_outputs: Source/config/test changes plus result, diff, logs, and evidence.
contract.state_side_effects: Authorized filesystem edits and subprocess/tool invocations occur in the builder workspace.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Unresolved operator, denied write scope, build/test failure, conflict, timeout, or unsafe command returns failed/blocked evidence.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Solar orchestrates external code agents; AGENTS.md states shipped runtime remains a Claude Code overlay, not an in-process code generator.
contract.success_evidence: Diff stays in scope, requested interface works, mandatory checks pass, and build evidence links to exact changes.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: new file; modify; config; test creation; scope denial; compile/test fail; conflict; rollback/no-change.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow and Appendix AutoSci Commands; docs/WORKFLOW_DESIGN.md Phases 2-5; AGENTS.md Scope and Local Workflow
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and harness/tools/codex_operator.py; agents/coder.md; no generic deterministic code-generation function
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Solar ships primarily as a Claude Code overlay. Concrete builds depend on selected physical operators, language toolchains, credentials, datasets, hardware, and approval/write-scope policy.

implementation.entrypoints: harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and harness/tools/codex_operator.py; agents/coder.md; no generic deterministic code-generation function
